subject: math
description: Derive and use properties of trapezoids and kites, including medians, isosceles trapezoid relationships, kite diagonals, and measure problems.
learningObjectives: Identify bases, legs, base angles, diagonals, medians, and symmetry diagonals in trapezoids and kites
Use the trapezoid median formula to find missing lengths
Apply isosceles trapezoid properties involving base angles and diagonals
Use kite properties involving adjacent congruent sides and perpendicular diagonals
Solve measure problems using properties of trapezoids and kites
prerequisites: Use congruent side and congruent angle markings in diagrams
